gaps.name: execute.md's new guardrail contradicts its own worktree settings-fix step
gaps.reason: behavior wrong - two instructions in one file cannot both be obeyed. The guardrail at execute.md:581-582 forbids the coordinator any Edit/Write outside .planning/ with no exception clause, while execute.md:186-190 requires the coordinator to merge `"worktree": {"baseRef": "head"}` into the project's .claude/settings.json or ~/.claude/settings.json on the user's accept. config.md:188-192 confirms that write is the model's own, through no seam.
gaps.evidence: cadence-core/workflows/execute.md:186-190 ('OFFER THE FIX HERE ... follow workflows/config.md's write rules: READ the target first ... merge the one key, preserve every other byte'); cadence-core/workflows/execute.md:581-582 ('This workflow's coordinator issues no `Edit` or `Write` against a path outside `.planning/`'); cadence-core/workflows/config.md:188-192 ('merge the one key in ... and write it back'). CONTEXT D-13 enumerates the writes the path wording permits and this site is absent from that list, so the omission is an oversight in the analysis rather than a decided carve-out. Live cost either way: a run obeying the guardrail declines a fix the user just accepted and parallel keeps falling back to sequential; a run obeying the step breaks a guardrail the phase added to be absolute.
gaps.missing: Decide which instruction wins and make the file say it once. Either scope the guardrail to what it was reasoned about - source under the repo, i.e. no Edit/Write of a path outside .planning/ EXCEPT the settings file the worktree step's own accept arm writes - or move that settings write behind a seam so the guardrail can stay absolute. Whichever is chosen, the prose-agreement guardrail assertion at prose-agreement.test.mjs (the /no `Edit` or `Write` against a path outside `\.planning\//` match) must be updated to the new wording in the same commit, or it reddens on the fix.

human_checks.name: Run /cad-execute on a phase whose plan trips the risk_surface gate to a FAIL, and watch who edits the source
human_checks.expected: The coordinator dispatches a continuation cad-executor under the failing plan's key and makes no Edit/Write of its own outside .planning/; .planning/trace.jsonl shows a second dispatch and close for that key around the fix commit
human_checks.why_human: Out of reach of any probe here, not merely unexercised: it needs a live multi-agent /cad-execute run against a real review provider, and no artifact records the answer even afterwards - .planning/reads.jsonl captures only the five read-shaped tools (hooks/hooks.json:16-27, lib/read-trace.mjs RECORDED_TOOLS), so a coordinator write inside the fix window leaves no trace to grep. Recording writes was deliberately deferred out of this phase (CONTEXT, Deferred). A person watching the run is the only observer of the ROADMAP's 'zero coordinator writes' clause.
